no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Per 2025 10-K, Cyclerion's current strategic focus is CYC-126, an individualized therapy for treatment-resistant depression (TRD), which is in early development (MIT license signed Sept 2025; Medsteer collaboration Jan 2026 for delivery technology). CYC-126 has not yet entered clinical trials and remains pre-IND. All legacy sGC stimulator assets have been licensed/sold to third parties (praliciguat to Akebia, zagociguat and CY3018 to Tisento) and ongoing trials of those assets are partner-sponsored. Olinciguat option agreement was terminated in October 2025; Cyclerion is exploring new licensees.
excluded_preclinical: CYC-126 (individualized TRD therapy) — pre-clinical / pre-IND; MIT-licensed Sept 2025; technology-enabled delivery via Medsteer Jan 2026
excluded_legacy_terminated: Multiple completed Cyclerion-sponsored Phase 1/2 sGC stimulator studies (12 COMPLETED, 1 TERMINATED)
excluded_partner_owned: Praliciguat — licensed to Akebia Therapeutics; Akebia initiated Phase 2 in focal segmental glomerulosclerosis (FSGS) Dec 2025 (partner-owned, $1M milestone earned to Cyclerion Feb 2026)
Zagociguat — sold to Tisento Therapeutics 2023; Tisento running PRIZM Phase 2b in MELAS (NCT06402123), enrollment completed Jan 2026; FDA Fast Track granted June 2025 (partner-owned)
Olinciguat — Cyclerion-owned but no active trials; option terminated Oct 2025
